record.reason: BlockBERT replaces dense self-attention with blockwise sparse attention and reports 27.8% lower inference time than RoBERTa at batch 8 and sequence length 1,024, with comparable QA accuracy. The evidence is for encoder-only BERT-family models and long-document QA rather than decoder-only LLM generation or serving. The attention idea is adjacent and potentially transferable, but the evaluated workload is outside core LLM inference, so it is retained as borderline.
record.title: Blockwise Self-Attention for Long Document Understanding
